summary.text: Jim Pressel is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 20, has served since 2016, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He owns a home-building and renovation business in Northwest Indiana.

paragraphs.text: Jim Pressel was born and raised in LaPorte County and is the owner of Pressel Enterprises Inc., a business that builds and renovates homes in Northwest Indiana.

He has been a member and president of the Indiana Builders Association and helped start the building trades program at New Prairie High School, which lets students gain experience for the construction workforce.
Pressel assumed office on November 9, 2016, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the November 3, 2026 general election he faces Democrat Laura Liskey.
